title: スマブラSP
about: 大乱闘スマッシュブラザーズ SPECIAL on Nintendo Switch. A person plays at the controls; Noa commentates on what the operator reports from the Studio (match start, KOs, result). No controller process: nothing is launched.

stage.about: HUD (measured 2026-10-19 on Nintendo's official play video, 2-fighter matches): damage and portraits at y 0.80-0.96 (box from 0.78, full width for 3-4 fighters), the timer at x 0.86-0.98 y 0.03-0.08, the score (spirit battles) at x 0.39-0.61 y 0.01-0.06; layout wide (operator 2026-10-19, 没入型): the game at 1600x900 and every overlay outside the picture
